description: Schéma Directeur des IRVE - Orléans Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Orléans Métropole. Schéma Directeur des Infrastructures de Recharge pour Véhicules Electriques (SDIRVE) d'Orléans Métropole. Echéance décembre 2025. Ce jeu de données est conforme au schéma national. Coverage: Orléans Métropole. The publisher named on the listing is Orléans Métropole. Its keywords include sdirve, transports-deplacements. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2025-01-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
